title: CloudWatch operator alerts built for triage
description: Turn CloudWatch alarms and events into operator notifications someone can act on without logging in to AWS: one message per incident, what broke, which site, the impact, the next step, a direct link, acknowledge or mute, one message on clearing. First slice, because this is the problem that started the initiative. Interim: the papyrus-monitoring alarm email stays until this replaces it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-04, refines this epic: acknowledgement is opt-in per kind (see kanbus-42a682), not on every incident; anyone can mute. First slice ends at kanbus-6275db. Plan: docs/notifications-plan.md.
